title: Kissinger on the 303 Committee overseeing covert operations

tellings.quote: The 303 committee was a secret US inter agency group that oversaw all covert operations and Kissinger was involved with it.

plain: Henry Kissinger was involved with the 303 Committee, which Michels describes as a secret US interagency group that oversaw all covert operations. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as part of asking whether Kissinger also oversaw a programme to recover crashed UFOs.
